reason: A presentation document-processing plugin that converts text or Markdown into themed HTML slides, editable PPTX files, and JSON manifests with local output.

summaries.zh: 将一句话、文本或 Markdown 内容转换为带主题的 HTML 演示文稿、可编辑 PPTX 文件和 JSON 清单。
summaries.en: Converts prompts, text, or Markdown into themed HTML presentations, editable PPTX files, and JSON manifests.

capabilities: Converts Markdown or structured slide content into HTML presentations
Generates editable PPTX files and JSON manifests
Writes generated artifacts to a user-specified local directory
Provides built-in presentation themes and bilingual interface text
